title: Adolescent depression recognition and symptom prediction based on multi-view EEG network: an exploratory study.
summary: A multi-view adaptive graph convolution model discriminated 44 depressed adolescents from 30 controls using EEG connectivity; the article reports subject-level 10-fold cross-validation, but no independent external cohort, so the results remain exploratory.
ai_technology: The MVA-GCN fuses PLV, PCC and PLI connectivity views through graph convolution/adaptive fusion to classify depression and derive network features.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: A multi-view adaptive graph convolution model discriminated 44 depressed adolescents from 30 controls using EEG connectivity; the article reports subject-level 10-fold cross-validation, but no independent external cohort, so the results remain exploratory.
evidence.unknown: Ten-fold cross-validation partitions at participant level (all epochs from one participant stay in one fold), addressing epoch leakage. Authors explicitly note modest sample and no independent external cohort; treat as proof-of-concept.
